description: One read-only check of the open CIVIL NX model for anything that is likely wrong, grouped into areas with a red/amber/green status each. DATA (no analysis needed): the Model Report's fourteen QC checks plus warped / badly shaped plates, plates facing the other way from their neighbours, nodes lying on an element without being joined to it (mesh cracks, beams resting on girders unconnected), beam lines that flip direction or whose beta angle jumps, material values out of range (unit slips), sections with zero area or inertia, plates with no thickness, rigid and elastic links that cannot work, supports holding nothing, self weight missing / upward / counted twice in a combination, upward dead loads, load values 1000× out of line, beam loads on plates, moving loads with no lanes or vehicles, construction stages (elements never activated, loads on parts not yet built, stages with no supports, activation order), combinations (cycles, unfactored ULS, duplicates, cases never combined), empty or unused groups, and tendons that cannot be stressed. UNITS (typing slips): creep/shrinkage and strength-gain inputs (fck in MPa typed into a kN/m² box, humidity as a fraction, notional size in mm in a metre model, shrinkage strains not × 10⁻⁶, strength not matching the linked concrete grade), tendon area / strengths / duct diameter / anchorage slip, thermal coefficients, temperatures, section depths and plate thicknesses. TENDONS: cover — every profile point placed on its girder and compared with the section's top and soffit (outside the concrete, with the likely coordinate slip: mm in a metre model or the sign of z; clear cover under 50 mm); jacking stress against min(0.8 fpk, 0.9 fp0.1k) and slips, duct area against the steel, friction μ and wobble ranges, friction loss estimated from each profile, sharp bends, profiles longer than their elements, tendons on elements that do not join up. MOVING LOADS (Eurocode EN 1991-2 and CS 454 / CS 458 rules): the moving-load code against the vehicles and cases; cases naming lanes or vehicles that do not exist, vehicles with no sub-type; duplicate names; lane widths against the code (Eurocode 3.0 m notional lanes or w/2 on 5.4–6 m; CS 454 3.0 m single / 2.5 m convoy, matched to the case's vehicle; SV lanes at least the vehicle width) with the slip named; remaining areas wide enough for another lane, ALL model 2 lane count and equal widths; lanes overlapping in one case; wheel spacing against the vehicles (BS stores a third, Eurocode the real value) and the lane; lanes off the deck (ECC sign flipped, mm in a metre model); lane element paths; Eurocode ψ — 'Ignore ψ factor' against a case named frequent / characteristic, ψ 0 or above 1, railway ψ1, and whether there are both characteristic and frequent LM1 cases; α factors (UK NA half entered), βQ and footway load; CS 458 SV speed against DAF, HB units. STAGES (set-up): creep/shrinkage links that reach no concrete or are switched off, activation ages under 1 day, too short a final stage, composite-section stages. RESULTS (when the model has been analysed): for every static load case the sum of reactions against the total applied load (equilibrium), the self-weight reaction against Σ density × element volume, displacements too large to be real (mechanisms, unit slips), and reaction symmetry on a symmetric model; on a construction-stage model, stages the analysis did not reach, stage displacements, and each stage's reactions against the weight and loads active then. Each with the numbers. Returns each check's result (pass / fail / not applicable / not run), severity, criterion and the ids involved. Reads only: GET /db tables, /ope/SECTPROP and POST /post/TABLE (REACTIONG, DISPLACEMENTG). On the website it runs as a job. Use model_qc_check for the plugin's fourteen checks alone, in another language.

displacements.description: Read nodal displacements for the displacement check (one table read per 2000 nodes × 10 load cases).

maxNodes.description: Most nodes to read displacements at; a larger model is sampled evenly.

outlierFactor.description: Element length outlier factor (the Model Report check).

parts.description: Which checks to run: data (model tables) and/or results (needs an analysed model). Default both.

thresholds.description: Override the limits the checks use (defaults in brackets).

collinearDeg.description: Beams within this angle count as one line [5].

displacementMechanism.description: Fail when a translation exceeds model size / this [50].

displacementPermanent.description: Warn when a dead-load case moves more than model size / this [250].

ductRatio.description: Smallest duct area / strand area for internal bonded tendons [2].

frictionLossPct.description: Warn when a tendon's estimated friction loss exceeds this, % [30].

laneOutsideDeck.description: Flag a traffic lane whose centre lies more than this beyond the outermost deck line, m [0.5].

minCoverMm.description: Smallest clear cover from a tendon duct to the section's top or soffit, mm [50].

minTendonRadius.description: Tightest allowed tendon bend radius, m [2.5].

outlierLoad.description: Load item this many times the case median (or 1/this) is an outlier [1000].

rotationMechanism.description: Fail when a rotation exceeds this, rad [0.1].

warpDeg.description: Plate warping limit, degrees between the two halves of a quad [10].

toleranceMm.description: Nodes closer than this (mm) count as coincident; also the distance at which a node counts as lying on an element.

name: model_health_check
title: Model health check (QC + results benchmarks)
